metadata.sensor_index: Sequential 0..35 in listed scene, setting, i order, identical across methods
metadata.force_metrics: method3.metric: t>=1s true axial force; L=ln(1+J), J capped at1000, force RMSE against8N; peak=max true F, >15 counted per episode
metadata.memory: rib_transition_eval.make_filter unchanged: >=6 ticks, R=4*(sigma/k)^2; IMM/EWA likelihood power1/4; forget_time includes Q_RATE_LO time floor; no forget_dist variant
metadata.oracle: 1.2*instantaneous true |K(20.8)| as window output through gates-off host, sigma=chi=0; unchanged side effects; truth verified at each call
metadata.transitions: rib_transition_eval.score unchanged; pooled A nominal, A slow_thin, A+B, large abs(delta log k)>=.3; rising/falling separately. Exact truth for scoring, .1s boxcar for detection, rate>.2/s, gaps<.1s merged.
metadata.transition_exclusions: Original rules: prior true-contact loss excludes event; episode force peak>36.5 excludes all its transitions. All exclusions and catastrophic episodes retained in JSON.
metadata.transition_metrics: lag grid0:.008:1.496 plus1.5s; local .5s pretransition median log bias removed (episode fallback recorded); settling abs(local error)<=.1 for .2s, cap2s; interval[t0,t1+.5]. Under-estimate = -min(log(hat/k)-local bias), signed; max across events is largest. Raw error also retained. Force peak_abs=max|F-8|; true F max also retained.
metadata.plateau: SE plateau masks; ln(hat/k) bias=per-episode median, sd=(Q75-Q25)/1.349; reported medians over episodes with plateau, including catastrophes. DO-MPAC is nominal fixed k_h0 only; Xing has no stiffness estimate.
metadata.too_few: n<5 marked; counts refer to method-specific closed-loop trajectories, not matched events
metadata.oracle_renamed: Rows named oracle were 1.2*tissue gain |K|, gates off, CENTRE on: a control margin diagnostic, not ideal identification. Renamed old_K_x1.2_margin. The ideal reference 1.0*k_eff is in completion_closed_loop.json.
metadata.stiffness_scoring_superseded: L, force_rmse and peak stay valid. legacy_col21_* used tissue gain log[:,21] and an event mask built only for breath_fast; stiffness accuracy and tracking now come from identification_replay.json with k_eff.
metadata.source_sha256_note: Hashes describe the code that produced these rows; evaluation edits since then do not change control, verified bitwise by identification_completion.py.

numerical_checks.memory_rest: Zero branch state and zero current/previous dy; remaining branch relaxation at rest is physical, not an exactly-zero response.

code_path_audit.live: Huber-D4/D4 plus Rossi-ID/Kalman/MHE via ContactAdapter; all gates-off variants and oracle; H/HA/HT and P5 share fix
W/S/WF/WA/WT; none of this comparison uses these contact forms; memory filters in the comparison are log-gain filters, not contact MEMORY
Its own optional branch; comparison Huber/D4 override _log with Preprocess; other comparison identifiers use ContactAdapter
Optional force/k_ref-dependent HC normalization, inactive in the requested configurations

code_path_audit.reason: Explicit window-end static-stiffening reference; window regressors recalculated, no transformed level cached; gamma=0 in requested methods
Current inverse-response or force/sliding increments integrated once; no episode-origin renormalization
Causal filtering/recursion, fixed references/filter coefficients; receives corrected H rows from ContactAdapter
Recalculates observation view using fixed calibrated delay and mass; acceleration compensation is causal; not online level renormalization
Complete independent controllers, their own equations; Rossi fixed-coefficient BP/EWRLS, DO fixed nominal gain, Xing no gain estimate

Offline old-form conditional reconstruction and explicit old/new ablation metadata; not comparison execution paths. h_fix_eval old default assumptions are superseded; use this script for current checks
